# Pictograms — Style Prompt

> A beat-locked flash-card film built from three things only: a **square-grid pattern** of discs, half-discs and tiny patterned cells whose rows slide past each other; **faceless geometric pictograms** made of round-capped bars and a disc head; and **huge bold type** that slides up out of masks, with a second-language line and mono HUD text in the corners. Every cut lands on a beat.

## 1. Essence, and what it is not

A **catalogue film**: N items (rules, steps, dishes, species, lessons) shown one card at a time, fast, on the beat. Each card is one pictogram doing one action, a huge title, a heavy second-language line and a mono index "01 / 03". Each card owns one hue. An emblem opening and a cover card start it; a big number card and a closing icon wall on a solid colour card end it.

A still reads as this look through four things:
1. **The grid pattern**: big discs and half-discs spanning square cells, about half the cells carrying a small motif, all in five tones of one hue, with whole rows cut and shifted sideways.
2. **The pictogram figure**: flat, faceless, rounded bars and a disc head; far-side limbs mixed toward the background. Props are discs, rings, capsules and lines.
3. **Type as architecture**: a very large heavy grotesk title, a heavy second line under it, small mono meta text in the corners like a broadcast HUD, a tick bar of N ticks.
4. **Beat lock**: every card starts on a beat, every key action lands on a beat.

Mood: premium public-signage identity; flat colour, one soft light sweep as the only gradient. Not an isometric infographic (no depth), not Swiss motion graphics (the figure and pattern carry as much as the type), not a cartoon (figures never emote and have no faces), not a data film.

## 2. Materials & rendering

- Flat colour, no outlines, no shadows. One square grid (cell 180 px at 1920×1080, one sixth of the height) rules the pattern, the bands and every transition.
- **Pattern model**: fill with a dark tone of the hue; on grid nodes place cell-radius discs in random tones, some with an inner disc; then about half the cells get one motif from a small library of generic geometry (quarter disc, half disc, disc with a small disc, striped half disc, wave scales, dot scales, triangle scales, concentric arcs, sun wheel, crescent), rotated by multiples of 90°. Paint it once, wider than the screen (16 cells), so any row can shift; never mascots, landmarks or logos.
- **Figure model**: unit = body height, origin at the hip; draw far limbs (mixed about 45% toward the card hue), torso, near limbs, head disc. Limb widths 0.094 (leg), 0.076 (arm), torso 0.145, head radius 0.082.
- **Stage**: the figure stands on a large sun disc in a lighter tone of the card hue (about 70% hue, 30% white), crossed once by a faint light sweep.

## 3. Colour logic

- **`--utama`, `--aksen` and a fixed green are the three hues**; each card uses one, in five tones (darker 32% and 16% toward black, the base, lighter 14% and 30% toward white). Cards take their text from the pair for that hue: `--teks-di-utama`, `--teks-di-aksen`, or `--teks-di-hijau`.
- Under type, a 78% flat layer of the hue lowers the pattern to low contrast; when the rows slide in, the pattern shows at full contrast for a beat before the layer arrives.
- The emblem and the cover sit on `--latar`; the closing card is a solid `--aksen` card with `--teks-di-aksen` text; text there is `--teks`, mono text `--teks-redup`, a hairline or keyword `--aksen-di-latar`, a price or key word `--utama-di-latar`.
- **Fixed, not from the brand**: the green, the gold (`--emas`) chip with its dark ink text, and the cream/ink pairing logic. Light hues take dark type and dark figures, so a pale brand colour flips the card to dark ink on its own.

## 4. Type

- `--font-judul`: Archivo Black, titles 224 px at 1920 wide (cover 196 px, closing 156 px), tight tracking (−0.02em), two stacked lines, max about 880 px wide; shrink for longer words instead of wrapping.
- Second-language line: Poppins 800, 72 px under the title. Body copy is rare; `--font-isi` is Poppins.
- Mono HUD (IBM Plex Mono 600): 24–36 px, 0.2em tracking, in the corners (series name left, "ATURAN 01" right, tag line under the title with a 3 px rule, index "01 / 03" and the tick bar bottom left). A tick bar of N ticks: the current tick full, the others about one third opacity.
- Bilingual rule: one language is always the big title, the other the heavy line, set per film, never per card.

## 5. Motion quality

- **Opening (about 1.6 s)**: on `--latar`, a small solid disc pops in and concentric round-capped arcs (radii 100, 152, 204 at 22 px, a thin outer ring at 256, in the hijau, accent, light-accent and gold tones) draw on one after another (0.8 s each, 0.15 s apart, `power2.inOut`), with a tiny mono caption above and below. Then a cream flash fades over 0.25 s while the pattern rows slide in to build the cover card.
- **Number card**: one flat full-hue card (top 2/3), a numeral at about 600 px in the title face counting up from 0 over 0.6 s, a heavy unit word beside it, a mono line typed on, two pattern rows below.
- **Closing card**: a solid bright hue (not the dark ground): title and chips in that hue's readable token, icon tiles in other hues, pattern rows along the bottom; holds still at least 2 s.
- One tempo for the film: 150 BPM, a beat is 0.4 s; a normal card is 7 beats (2.8 s). Key actions land on whole beats.
- Easing: expo out for entrances and mask slides, power4 out for row slides, one `back.out(1.3)` at most (the sun disc pop). Sine in the figure's own loops.
- **Rows**: on entry each of the 6 rows slides 1920 px in from alternating sides, stagger 0.05 s, 0.55 s. While on screen, cover and closing rows step a quarter cell (about 40 px) per beat in alternating directions, each beat eased with expo out over 0.3 s.
- **Type** enters by mask slide-up: title lines first (0.08 s apart), the second language 0.17 s later, mono lines typed on with no caret (0.6 s for 20 characters).
- **Figure assembly**: four horizontal bands (25% each) slide into register from alternating sides, 0.55 s, 0.06 s apart; then it acts: a rinse, a cap lifted and set, a walk one step per beat.
- Endings hold still for at least 2 s; rows stop moving before the end.

## 6. Camera grammar

A locked flat frame; energy comes from row slides, the figure's action and the sweep. Never dissolves, 3D, shake or depth of field.

| Move | What it expresses | Can serve |
|---|---|---|
| Locked flat frame | clarity, the card as a poster | any item that must be read |
| Rows sliding in from alternating sides | change of chapter | next rule, next dish, next lesson |
| Quarter-cell row steps on the beat | a pulse under the title | cover cards, closing cards |
| Pull back to a wall of tiles | the whole set at once | summary, "all of them", roster |
| Split along a grid line | two items side by side | right vs wrong, before/after |
| Vertical scroll by grid rows | ranking, descent | top ten, floors, depths |

## 7. Native moves

- **One card, one item.** The count is the hook. *Fits content like:* the rules of a pool or a library; every station of a bus line; every dish of a regional menu; the muscles of a hand in a class.
- **One verb per item.** One body action readable in a bar, or a prop action (a cap, a cup, a gear). *Fits content like:* yoga poses; kitchen techniques; first-aid steps; jobs on a building site.
- **Chapter = hue.** Families become hues so the viewer always knows where they are. *Fits content like:* food groups; sections of an orchestra; departments of a clinic.
- **Icon wall.** All pictograms return as square tiles with labels. *Fits content like:* a year in review; a team roster; the habits of a channel.
- **Emblem opening.** Concentric arcs drawn on around a disc, then a flash into the cover. *Fits content like:* a pool or a bathhouse (ripples); a radio class (waves); a bell tower; a club badge.
- **Count-up slam.** A huge number on a flat hue card. *Fits content like:* kilos recycled; members of a club; days to an opening.

## 8. Pitfalls

- Cream on a light hue fails contrast: light hues take dark type and dark figures.
- The sun disc vanishes on a dark hue: it must be a lighter tone.
- Props that spread into the text column: keep the stage to the right 40% of the frame, the text column to the left.
- Dense pattern under type: always lay the flat hue layer over it.
- Copying a real games or sports identity: use your own palette, mark and motifs.

# Pictograms: beat plan

Default length 15 s. Tempo per beat (seconds): short 1.6, medium 2.8, long 3.6.

## hook

- en: dark emblem: a disc and five-tone concentric arcs draw on stroke by stroke; cream flash, then rows slide in to build the cover
- id: lambang gelap: cakram dan busur sepusat digambar bergantian; kilat krem, lalu baris pola menyapu masuk membangun sampul

## problem

- en: one pictogram in a no-sign ring with a slash on a dark neutral card; the grid stays low contrast, the title slams up from a mask
- id: satu piktogram di cincin larangan bercoret pada kartu gelap; pola grid redup, judul menyembul dari topeng

## fact

- en: one card, one item: rows of the hue slide in, a sun disc pops, the pictogram builds from four bands, title and second language slide up
- id: satu kartu satu hal: baris pola masuk, cakram matahari muncul, piktogram datang dari empat pita, judul dan baris kedua menyembul

## step

- en: one verb per card on the beat: rows sweep in, the figure acts once in a loop-able gesture, mono index 01 / 03 and tick bar advance
- id: satu kata kerja per kartu tepat ketukan: baris menyapu masuk, figur melakukan satu gerakan, indeks mono 01 / 03 dan batang tik maju

## compare

- en: split on a grid line: left half in one hue with the wrong pictogram, right half in another with the right one, titles under each
- id: dibelah di garis grid: kiri satu hue dengan piktogram yang salah, kanan hue lain dengan yang benar, judul di bawah masing-masing

## number

- en: one full-colour card: a huge numeral counts up on the beat, a heavy unit word beside it, a typed mono line, pattern rows below
- id: satu kartu warna penuh: angka raksasa naik di ketukan, kata satuan tebal di sampingnya, baris mono diketik, baris pola di bawah

## proof

- en: icon wall: every pictogram returns as a square tile in its hue, tiles pop in one by one with a mono label under each
- id: dinding ikon: semua piktogram kembali sebagai ubin berwarna, muncul satu per satu dengan label mono di bawahnya

## offer

- en: a flat hue card with the offer in the title face and a pictogram on the sun disc; the mono line gives the terms, typed on
- id: kartu hue polos dengan penawaran berhuruf judul dan piktogram di cakram matahari; baris mono memuat syarat, diketik

## cta

- en: a solid bright colour card: icon tiles pop in, hours and contact as two flat chips, pattern rows below; holds still 2 s
- id: kartu satu warna cerah: ubin ikon muncul, jam dan kontak jadi dua chip datar, baris pola di bawah; diam 2 detik

## payoff

- en: the last pictogram stays on its disc while the pattern rows stop one by one, leaving the grid and a quiet closing line
- id: piktogram terakhir tinggal di cakramnya sementara baris pola berhenti satu per satu, menyisakan grid dan satu kalimat penutup

<html lang="id">
  <head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8" />
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=1920, height=1080" />
    <title>Piktogram</title>
    <script src="/_lib/gsap@3.15.1/gsap.min.js"></script>
    <style>
      @font-face { font-family: "Archivo Black"; src: url("data:font/woff2;base64,"); font-weight: 400; }
      @font-face { font-family: "Poppins"; src: url("data:font/woff2;base64,"); font-weight: 800; }
      @font-face { font-family: "IBM Plex Mono"; src: url("data:font/woff2;base64,"); font-weight: 600; }
      /* Token brand (recipes/README.md): brand mengganti dua belas nilai pertama. */
      :root {
        --latar: #0f0c15; --latar-2: #1e1a27; --utama: #e83220; --aksen: #4e3a93;
        --teks: #fbf6ec; --teks-redup: #9a93a8; --teks-di-utama: #fbf6ec; --teks-di-aksen: #fbf6ec;
        --utama-di-latar: #ec5a26; --aksen-di-latar: #d5b102;
        --font-judul: "Archivo Black", "Noto Sans", sans-serif; --font-isi: "Poppins", "Noto Sans", sans-serif;
        /* Warna khas gaya ini, tetap di semua brand: hue ketiga dan emas lengkap dengan teksnya. */
        --hijau: #079a3e; --teks-di-hijau: #fbf6ec; --emas: #d5b102; --teks-di-emas: #211904;
        --font-kode: "IBM Plex Mono", "Noto Sans", monospace;
      }
      * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
      html, body { width: 1920px; height: 1080px; overflow: hidden; background: var(--latar); }
      #root { position: relative; width: 1920px; height: 1080px; overflow: hidden; background: var(--latar); color: var(--teks); font-family: var(--font-isi); }
      .sc { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; width: 1920px; height: 1080px; overflow: hidden; background: var(--latar); }
      .sc + .sc { visibility: hidden; }
      .sc[data-role="step"] { background: transparent; }
      .flat { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; width: 1920px; height: 720px; background: var(--h); }
      .num { position: absolute; left: 90px; top: 110px; font: 400 600px/1 var(--font-judul); letter-spacing: -0.04em; color: var(--fg); }
      .unit { position: absolute; left: 900px; top: 400px; font: 800 110px/1.1 var(--font-isi); color: var(--fg); }
      #emb { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; width: 1920px; height: 1080px; }
      .bg { position: absolute; inset: 0; background: var(--h, var(--latar)); }
      .row { position: absolute; left: 0; width: 1920px; height: 180px; overflow: hidden; }
      .row img { position: absolute; display: block; width: 2880px; height: 1080px; left: -360px; }
      .ov { position: absolute; inset: 0; background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--h) 78%, transparent); }
      .disc { position: absolute; left: 1060px; top: 190px; width: 700px; height: 700px; border-radius: 50%; overflow: hidden; background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--h) 70%, white); }
      .disc b { position: absolute; left: 0; top: -100px; width: 150px; height: 900px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, color-mix(in oklab, white 34%, transparent), transparent); }
      .pic svg { position: absolute; left: 1030px; top: 170px; width: 760px; height: 760px; overflow: visible; }
      svg .far { stroke: color-mix(in oklab, var(--fg) 55%, var(--h)); fill: none; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; }
      svg .near { stroke: var(--fg); fill: none; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; }
      svg circle.near, svg .pf { fill: var(--fg); stroke: none; }
      svg .pr { stroke: var(--fg); fill: none; stroke-linecap: round; }
      .hud, .tag, .idx, .lab { position: absolute; font: 600 24px/1 var(--font-kode); letter-spacing: 0.2em; white-space: nowrap; }
      .sc[style*="--fg"] .hud, .sc[style*="--fg"] .tag, .sc[style*="--fg"] .idx { color: var(--fg); }
      .hud.a { left: 110px; top: 70px; } .hud.b { right: 110px; top: 70px; }
      .t { position: absolute; left: 100px; top: 215px; font: 400 224px/0.9 var(--font-judul); letter-spacing: -0.02em; color: var(--fg); }
      .m { display: block; overflow: hidden; padding: 0.05em 0.1em 0.03em 0; }
      .m > span { display: block; }
      .en { position: absolute; left: 110px; top: 670px; font: 800 72px/1.1 var(--font-isi); color: var(--fg); }
      .tag { left: 114px; top: 800px; font-size: 26px; padding-bottom: 12px; border-bottom: 3px solid var(--fg); }
      .idx { left: 114px; top: 940px; font-size: 36px; }
      .ticks { position: absolute; left: 330px; top: 953px; display: flex; gap: 12px; }
      .ticks i { width: 72px; height: 10px; background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--fg) 32%, transparent); }
      .ticks i.on { background: var(--fg); }
      /* Sampul: dua baris pola di atas, pita gelap di tengah, dua baris di bawah. */
      .band { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 360px; width: 1920px; height: 360px; background: var(--latar); }
      .big { position: absolute; left: 100px; font: 400 208px/1 var(--font-judul); letter-spacing: -0.02em; color: var(--teks); }
      .sub { position: absolute; left: 110px; font: 800 54px/1.1 var(--font-isi); color: var(--teks); }
      .mono { position: absolute; left: 114px; font: 600 24px/1 var(--font-kode); letter-spacing: 0.2em; color: var(--teks-redup); white-space: nowrap; }
      .bar { position: absolute; left: 114px; top: 706px; width: 190px; height: 10px; background: var(--aksen-di-latar); }
      .tile { position: absolute; top: 120px; width: 210px; height: 210px; background: var(--h); }
      .tile i { position: absolute; left: 20px; top: 20px; width: 170px; height: 170px; border-radius: 50%; background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--h) 70%, white); }
      .tile svg { position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 210px; height: 210px; overflow: visible; }
      .lab { top: 346px; font-size: 20px; color: var(--fg); }
      .chip { position: absolute; left: 110px; padding: 18px 28px; font: 600 30px/1 var(--font-kode); letter-spacing: 0.14em; white-space: nowrap; }
    </style>
  </head>
  <body>
    <div id="root" data-composition-id="main" data-start="0" data-duration="15" data-width="1920" data-height="1080" data-fps="30">
      <!-- 0-1,6 s hook: lambang kolam, busur sepusat digambar satu per satu di latar gelap. -->
      <div class="sc" id="cemb" data-role="hook">
        <p class="mono" style="top: 150px; left: 0; width: 1920px; text-align: center">KOLAM WARGA TIRTA ASRI</p>
        <svg id="emb" viewBox="0 0 1920 1080"></svg>
        <p class="mono" style="top: 915px; left: 0; width: 1920px; text-align: center">RW 05 · 2026 · BUKA 06.00-18.00</p>
      </div>
      <!-- 1,6-3,4 s kilat krem, lalu baris pola menyapu masuk: kartu sampul. -->
      <div class="sc" id="c0" data-role="hook">
        <div class="band"></div>
        <p class="mono" style="top: 398px">KOLAM WARGA TIRTA ASRI · RW 05</p>
        <h1 class="big m" style="top: 440px"><span>KOLAM WARGA</span></h1>
        <p class="sub m" style="top: 640px"><span>Poolside rules, 3 langkah aman</span></p>
        <i class="bar"></i>
        <i class="bg" id="fl" style="background: var(--teks)"></i>
      </div>
      <!-- Tiga kartu langkah (isinya dibuat skrip dari STEPS): satu piktogram, satu kata kerja. -->
      <div class="sc" id="c1" data-role="step" style="--h: var(--utama); --fg: var(--teks-di-utama)"></div>
      <div class="sc" id="c2" data-role="step" style="--h: var(--aksen); --fg: var(--teks-di-aksen)"></div>
      <div class="sc" id="c3" data-role="step" style="--h: var(--hijau); --fg: var(--teks-di-hijau)"></div>
      <!-- Kartu angka: satu hue penuh, angka raksasa naik di ketukan, dua baris pola mengintip di bawah. -->
      <div class="sc" id="cn" data-role="number" style="--h: var(--utama); --fg: var(--teks-di-utama)">
        <i class="flat"></i>
        <p class="hud a">KOLAM WARGA TIRTA ASRI</p>
        <h2 class="num m"><span id="nv">25</span></h2>
        <p class="unit m"><span>METER</span></p>
        <p class="tag" style="left: 904px; top: 560px"></p>
      </div>
      <!-- 11-15 s cta: dinding ikon dan jam buka, ditahan diam. -->
      <div class="sc" id="c4" data-role="cta" style="--h: var(--aksen); --fg: var(--teks-di-aksen)">
        <i class="bg"></i>
        <h2 class="big" style="top: 100px; font-size: 156px; line-height: 0.92; color: var(--fg)"><span class="m"><span>SELAMAT</span></span><span class="m"><span>BERENANG</span></span></h2>
        <p class="sub m" style="top: 420px; color: var(--fg)"><span>Swim safe, swim happy</span></p>
        <span class="chip" style="top: 540px; background: var(--emas); color: var(--teks-di-emas)">BUKA 06.00-18.00 · SETIAP HARI</span>
        <span class="chip" style="top: 625px; background: var(--utama); color: var(--teks-di-utama)">Chat 0812-3456-7890</span>
      </div>
    </div>
    <script>
      const tl = gsap.timeline({ paused: true });
      const NS = "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg";
      const $ = (s) => document.querySelector(s);
      const mk = (tag, cls) => Object.assign(document.createElement(tag), { className: cls || "" });
      const clamp = (x) => Math.max(0, Math.min(1, x));
      const inv = (a, b, x) => clamp((x - a) / (b - a));
      const oExp = (t) => (t >= 1 ? 1 : 1 - Math.pow(2, -10 * clamp(t)));
      const io3 = (t) => (t < 0.5 ? 4 * t * t * t : 1 - Math.pow(-2 * t + 2, 3) / 2);
      const rng = (seed) => {
        let a = seed >>> 0;
        return () => {
          a = (a + 0x6d2b79f5) | 0;
          let t = Math.imul(a ^ (a >>> 15), 1 | a);
          t = (t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), 61 | t)) ^ t;
          return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
        };
      };
      // ===== 1. Pola grid: lingkaran, setengah lingkaran, sel bermotif; lima nada dari satu hue =====
      const probe = $("#root").appendChild(mk("i"));
      const col = (x) => { probe.style.color = x; return window["getComputedStyle"](probe).color; };
      const mixc = (base, pct, to) => col(`color-mix(in srgb, ${base} ${pct}%, ${to})`);
      const CELL = 180;
      const disc = (c, x, y, r, f) => { c.fillStyle = f; c.beginPath(); c.arc(x, y, r, 0, 6.2832); c.fill(); };
      function motif(c, kind, x, y, s, T, r) {
        c.save();
        c.beginPath(); c.rect(x, y, s, s); c.clip();
        c.fillStyle = T.a; c.fillRect(x, y, s, s);
        c.translate(x + s / 2, y + s / 2); c.rotate(Math.floor(r() * 4) * Math.PI / 2); c.translate(-s / 2, -s / 2);
        if (kind === 0) disc(c, 0, 0, s, T.b);
        else if (kind === 1) disc(c, s / 2, s, s / 2, T.b);
        else if (kind === 2) { disc(c, s / 2, s / 2, s / 2, T.b); disc(c, s * 0.62, s * 0.42, s * 0.13, T.c); }
        else if (kind === 3) { // matahari terbenam bergaris
          c.beginPath(); c.arc(s / 2, s, s / 2, Math.PI, 0); c.clip();
          for (let i = 0; i < 7; i++) { c.fillStyle = i % 2 ? T.b : T.c; c.fillRect(0, s / 2 + i * s / 14, s, s / 14); }
        } else if (kind === 5) { // lingkaran bertitik
          disc(c, s / 2, s / 2, s / 2, T.b);
          for (let j = 0; j < 7; j++) for (let i = 0; i < 7; i++) disc(c, i * s / 6 + (j % 2 ? s / 12 : 0), j * s / 6, s * 0.06, T.c);
        } else if (kind === 7) for (let i = 5; i >= 1; i--) disc(c, 0, s, s * i / 5, i % 2 ? T.b : T.a); // busur sepusat
        else if (kind === 9) { disc(c, s / 2, s / 2, s * 0.46, T.b); disc(c, s * 0.66, s * 0.38, s * 0.4, T.a); }
        else { disc(c, 0, s / 2, s / 2, T.b); disc(c, s, s / 2, s / 2, T.c); }
        c.restore();
      }
      // Satu kanvas 2880x1080 per hue, dilukis sekali lalu jadi gambar; lebih lebar supaya baris bisa digeser.
      function pattern(base, seed) {
        const T5 = [mixc(base, 68, "black"), mixc(base, 84, "black"), col(base), mixc(base, 86, "white"), mixc(base, 70, "white")];
        const cv = mk("canvas"); cv.width = 2880; cv.height = 1080;
        const c = cv.getContext("2d"), r = rng(seed);
        c.fillStyle = T5[1]; c.fillRect(0, 0, 2880, 1080);
        for (let j = -1; j < 6; j++) for (let i = -1; i < 16; i++) {
          const k = r();
          if (k < 0.34) disc(c, i * CELL + CELL, j * CELL + CELL, CELL, T5[Math.floor(r() * 4)]);
